name: Necromantic Casting Glow (Drakness signature)
description: Necromantic magic gathers around her raised hand - swirling amethyst-and-violet soul energy, thin ribbons of dark smoke, and faint spectral shades rising from the ground around her. A cold violet glow runs along the edge of her weapon's blade.
notes: Hero-signature casting effect, tied to Drakness's Darkness/Necromancer class and amethyst palette — grounded in prompts/_archive/Drakness/final/Drakness_FireRed_SD-001_Final.txt.
